Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, grant me success in this day to be in harmony with the righteous
And keep me away in this day from the company of the evil ones

Arabic text: وَ آوِنِيْ فِيْهِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ إِلَى دَارِ القَرَارِ
Translation: And shelter me in this day, by Your mercy, in the eternal abode
By Your Divinity, O God of the worlds
